Commentary: Axar Patel to Shamar Springer, SIX, WI need six sixes for a super over, and Shamar Springer gets one over deep mid-wicket to start the over with a maximum. This was right in the slot. Can he hit five more?
Axar Patel to Shamar Springer, no run, all over! Axar Patel drifts one in, and Shamar Springer can only edge it back into the pitch
Axar Patel to Shamar Springer, FOUR, short and wide, Shamar Springer slaps it towards deep point for a boundary as the fielder can't get across
Axar Patel to Shamar Springer, SIX, connects this one alright, gets the length and smokes it over deep square leg for a six
Axar Patel to Shamar Springer, no run, Shamar Springer fails to get the timing right on this fullish delivery, and the ball drops safely in front of the fielder at long-on. They don't take a single

Axar Patel to Shamar Springer, SIX, this one has gone all the way, but it doesn't matter! India have managed to defend a total. They win this by 14 runs and take a 2-1 lead in the series. Shamar Springer sends this one over long-off and does it off the back foot, but it's all too late for West Indies
